# Local vendor assets

These files are bundled locally so the three WebGL labs do not depend on school-network access to public CDNs.

- Three.js r128 and OrbitControls — MIT license, see `three-r128/LICENSE`.
- Tailwind browser runtime — MIT license, see `tailwind/LICENSE`.
- Font Awesome Free 6.4.0 — see `fontawesome/LICENSE.txt`.

Source versions are intentionally pinned. Upgrade only with a full visual and interaction regression test of all labs.
